ModMetaData.name: Project Mamono Reptiles
ModMetaData.author: Gapho
ModMetaData.description:
Adds eleven reptile mamonos to RimWorld 1.6, and two mountain factions.
The eleven species are the basilisk, lamia, medusa, wurm, dragon, lizardman, wyvern, malef dragon, dragonewt, salamander and bunyip. Five of them move on a serpent tail in place of legs. Three of them have wings. Each one has her own body, her own hide and her own corpse.
Every one of them carries the reptilian gene. It gives sharp scales, a comfortable temperature 10 degrees warmer than a human's, a single egg in place of a live birth, and a hide shed once a year. Cold does not kill her: it slows her, then puts her to sleep until she is warm again.
Two factions hold the mountains. Dragonia is neutral and trades. The Scalebound Broods are hostile, raid your colony, and never trade.
Dragonian traders sell scales, a violet metal, dragon orbs, wedding collars and wine. A dragon orb that is installed and lit at night can draw a wild dragon to the map. Dark dragon's blood turns an ordinary woman into a dragonewt, and a dragonewt into a malef dragon.
In game you meet them as raiders, as wild women you can tame, as traders, and as women you take in. Butchering one gives mamono meat, and her corpse gives her own hide.
Requires Harmony, Biotech, Project Mamono, Big and Small - Framework, and Vanilla Expanded Framework.
